title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
ii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iii.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
iv.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
v.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
